## Invitations

A total of 6979 invitations were issued during the reporting period. Attendance was recorded for 5283 people, representing a rate of 75.7 per cent. The figures provide a summary of invitation activity and attendance for North City in the quarter.

The attendance result will continue to inform routine outreach monitoring. Records of invitations and attendance should be maintained together to support consistent review of engagement.

## Contact

SMS contact was recorded for 5904 invitees. A reminder was also recorded for 5904 invitees. These contact figures are reported alongside invitations and attendance to provide a clear account of outreach activity.

Staff continue to phone people who missed two appointments. This follow-up remains part of the contact process and supports continued engagement with invitees who did not attend as expected.

Prepared by G. Evans.
